kind: deterministic sandbox command probe, not a benchmark Actor run
command:
require 'json'; require 'socket'
r = {}
r['actor_read'] = File.read('visible.txt').strip
File.write('actor-written.txt', "WRITE_ALLOWED\n")
r['actor_write'] = File.read('actor-written.txt').strip
{'hidden_controller'=>'/tmp/codekick-controller-probe.VKVmTD/hidden.txt', 'product_controller'=>'/Users/mac/code/codekick/evals/baseline.json'}.each do |label,path|
  begin
    File.read(path)
    r[label] = 'UNEXPECTED_READ_ALLOWED'
  rescue Errno::EPERM, Errno::EACCES
    r[label] = 'DENIED'
  rescue => e
    r[label] = e.class.to_s + ':' + e.message
  end
end
begin
  s = Socket.tcp('1.1.1.1', 443, connect_timeout: 2)
  s.close
  r['network'] = 'UNEXPECTED_CONNECTION_ALLOWED'
rescue Errno::EPERM, Errno::EACCES
  r['network'] = 'DENIED'
rescue => e
  r['network'] = e.class.to_s + ':' + e.message
end
puts JSON.generate(r)
